spec.name: Halloween Haunted Gingerbread House
spec.description: An edible Orange SMP Halloween cottage with stepped chocolate roofing, icing cobwebs, amber candy windows and a tiny ghost sweet guarding the door. Axis-aligned, editable geometry fits entirely within 0..16. Transparent space remains around the eaves and ghost silhouette.

prompt: Small edible haunted gingerbread cottage with chocolate roof, white icing cobwebs, orange candy windows and tiny ghost sweet at door, fits0..16 all axes. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
